description: This file defines an interface 'ITestClusterPortAllocator' within the 'Orleans.TestingHost' namespace, responsible for allocating unused network ports for testing clusters, specifically providing functionality to allocate consecutive port pairs.

classes.name: ITestClusterPortAllocator
classes.description: Interface for allocating unused ports for testing clusters, supporting port allocation for silo and gateway endpoints.

methods.name: AllocateConsecutivePortPairs
methods.description: Allocates consecutive port pairs for testing purposes, returning a tuple of base ports for silo and gateway endpoints.
